purpose: Production-ready backend database service for main-site knowledge pull and full-corpus import operations.
runtime_principles: Do not import full corpus at API boot.
All public responses must be public-safe and approved or verified.
All internal sync endpoints require x-pinuyumayan-main-site-key.
Long-running jobs must use job queue records and locks.
Preview subset and full corpus must remain distinguishable in every import and API response.

readiness_checks.description: Required environment variables are present and safe.
DATABASE_URL is configured and DB ping succeeds.
80 preview entries are present for initial UI.
Internal pull key is configured in production.
